composition_subtypes.role: Sort input to enable efficient two-pointer scanning from extremes.
Greedily adjust min or max using two pointers based on remaining operations.
Move left and right pointers monotonically with O(1) amortized updates.

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort array, then use a greedy two-pointer approach with amortized updates to minimize max-min difference within k operations.
payload.rationale: Solution sorts input, then applies a two-pointer greedy method that moves pointers monotonically to spend operations efficiently. Amortized analysis ensures linear time. Multiple coordinated mechanisms: sorting, greedy, amortized.
